_comment: All texts of the game (English). PLACEHOLDER lines, to be rewritten. Tokens: {name:id} = display name from names.json, {text:key} = another text, {n} etc. = values from the code.
title.subtitle: prototype
board.notice.default: Lovely day on {name:place_world}! {n} adventurers expected. Smile!
board.notice.sunny: Sunny with a chance of adventurers ({n})! Hydrate and smile!
world.bell_evening: *ding* End of shift. Time to go home.
dlg.mentor.greet_1: Morning. I'm {name:mentor}. I've told you that three hundred and forty times, but it's fine.
dlg.mentor.greet_2: Morning. {name:mentor}. You won't remember. I do.
dlg.mentor.tasks: Three jobs today: the pot by the path, the chest by the old tree, the trampled grass. Same as always.
dlg.mentor.tip_1: Pots go back on the pedestal. Shards point up. Don't ask me why.
dlg.mentor.colleagues: Lost two of the lads on the path this week. Well. 'Lost.' They're back. You know what I mean.
dlg.mentor.idle_1: Heroes take the path at nine and at two. Be somewhere else.
dlg.mentor.idle_2: Somebody left a job half done. Somebody always does.
dlg.mentor.question_2: Ever wonder why the pots always break right where we work?
dlg.colleague.idle: Lowkey love this spot. Great view of the path, no cap.
dlg.colleague.warn_narration: {name:protagonist} wobbles toward the path, then back.
dlg.colleague.warn_reply: Oh. Oh! Heroes? Bestie, you ate. I'm out.
dlg.home.kid_plays: {name:kid} is in the corner with a wooden sword, defeating a rag slime.
dlg.kid.play: Hyah! Take that, slime! Level up!
end.title: End of the prototype
end.body:
{name:mentor} asked a question. {name:protagonist} will not remember it. You will.

Days: {days}   Incidents: {incidents}
battle.log.falls_asleep: {hero} breathes the spores and falls asleep.
battle.log.absorb_mud: The Slime absorbs some mud. It feels heavy.
battle.log.absorb_spores: The Slime absorbs a blue mushroom. Spores everywhere.
battle.log.absorb_nothing: The Slime looks for something to absorb.
battle.log.hide_nowhere: The Slime has nowhere to hide.
battle.log.too_heavy: The Slime is too heavy to run.
battle.log.heroes_leave: The party moves on. No EXP here.
battle.bored.3: {name:hero_sword}: Nothing personal. I've got a quota.
world.day_end: It's dark. {name:protagonist} finds the way home anyway.
world.walk_home_hint: Home is past the sign, bottom left.
